avoid-anthropocentric-bias.note: The inherited article contained unsupported survey ranges, volunteer outcomes, immediate-effect claims and rigid observation targets. The effective public record is rewritten as a low-risk observation-versus-interpretation check without an evidence claim.

avoid-contrast-effect.note: The inherited article contained fabricated trials, laboratory ranges, hiring outcomes and savings claims. The effective public record is rewritten as an independent-assessment protocol without an evidence claim.

avoid-gamblers-fallacy-trust-the-odds.note: The inherited article contained fabricated tests, financial action rules, arbitrary confidence and sample thresholds, and adherence claims. The effective public record is rewritten as a dependence-and-stop-rule check without an evidence claim.

avoid-selection-bias-in-analysis.note: The inherited article contained unsupported mistake reduction, conversion examples, sample prescriptions and statistical precision. The effective public record is rewritten as an inclusion-rule and conclusion-scope check without an evidence claim.

avoid-anthropocentric-bias.reason: The effective protocol separates observable facts from interpretation and compares alternative explanations. Critical Thinking is the additional concrete Topic; the legacy Cognitive Biases collection already supplies the canonical bias Topic.

avoid-contrast-effect.reason: The effective protocol defines stable criteria, assesses options independently and then resolves trade-offs. Decision Making is the additional concrete Topic; the legacy Cognitive Biases collection remains the bias Topic.

avoid-gamblers-fallacy-trust-the-odds.reason: The effective protocol distinguishes independent from connected events and applies a pre-defined rule under uncertainty. Decision Making and Data Literacy are the additional concrete Topics; the legacy Cognitive Biases collection remains the bias Topic.

avoid-selection-bias-in-analysis.reason: The effective protocol inspects inclusion, exclusion and missing cases before generalizing. Critical Thinking and Data Literacy are the additional concrete Topics; the legacy Cognitive Biases collection remains the bias Topic.
